audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads FAV but the tone token is the red 'hard' colour and the prose says 'Hard matchup'.
audit.why: 56.05% over 2580 games is a Mundo-favoured lane that is won early and conceded late — the red token misreads it at a glance, which is the one thing a loading screen must not do.
audit.corrected: tone recoloured to the FAV token used elsewhere in this champion's data.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart was inverted against its own prose and against the packet. win[0..3] and phases[0..3].side gave Jax levels 1 through 4-5, while whys[0..3] read 'is yours', 'favours you', 'stays yours', 'remains yours'; win[4..6] said 'Skill' while whys[4..6] say Jax takes 6, first item and late. The packet levelChart is Dr. Mundo x4 then Jax x3.
audit.why: Pre-6 Jax has no ultimate, 50-90 mana on Counter Strike and thin sustain; post-6 Grandmaster-at-Arms and Blade of the Ruined King beat a tank build. The lane genuinely inverts at 6.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Dr. Mundo / Dr. Mundo / Dr. Mundo / Dr. Mundo / Jax / Jax / Jax across both layers as one atomic group, ratings rescaled, and all seven phases[].why rewritten — every one of them described the opposite champion.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. (a) Jax's ultimate is called 'Grandmaster's Might' in whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.foe[0]; Riot's current name is Grandmaster-at-Arms, and its damage is a magic proc on every third consecutive attack, not a blanket 'on-hit'. (b) Counter Strike was described as 'dodges autos + stuns' with no statement of what it does NOT dodge — Riot's text is 'dodge all incoming attacks'. Abilities are not attacks: Infected Bonesaw keeps landing through the whole dodge window. Mundo's passive also eats the Counter Strike stun outright, which was never said.
audit.why: 'Keep throwing Q into his E' is the single most useful sentence in this matchup and it was nowhere on the page; instead the page told the player to stop attacking and wait.
audit.corrected: Ultimate renamed everywhere it was edited, third-hit proc stated, and 'dodges attacks, not abilities — keep throwing Q' plus the passive-eats-one-stun interaction written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], breakdown.early and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Counter Strike given as '8s' in breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].
audit.why: It is 17/15/13/11/9. An 8s figure makes the downtime look unusable; the true rank-1 17s is the widest free window Mundo gets in the whole lane.
audit.corrected: '17s at rank 1, 9s maxed', and phases[2].why now sells that downtime explicitly.

edits.before: Your worst level in the game — base stats lose every straight trade. Throw Infected Bonesaw from max range, last-hit, and conserve the health pool Jax wants to chip.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours — Jax has no Counter Strike yet and thin sustain. Throw Infected Bonesaw from max range, take the short trade, and bank the health pool he wants later.

edits.before: Still Jax's window. Heart Zapper absorbs a chunk of burst and pays it back — take only the trades where your W can cash its damage store.
edits.after: Still yours. Heart Zapper absorbs a chunk of his burst and pays it back — take the trades where your W can cash its store before he leaps out.

edits.before: Full kit online and your passive shrugs the first CC. Cleaver poke plus E-empowered swats start the grind; never brawl while Counter Strike is up.
edits.after: Full kit online and your passive shrugs his first stun. Counter Strike is 17s at rank 1 — that downtime is the widest free window you get all game.

edits.before: Q ranks make the cleaver chunk real HP and your passive regen ramps. Jax must kill you through the sustain or watch you out-scale — most can't.
edits.after: Q ranks make the cleaver chunk real HP and your regen ramps. Cash the lane now — Jax has no ultimate yet, and this is the last stage cleanly yours.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage online — dives and all-ins flip when you press R mid-fight and regen half your HP. Force Jax to commit, then out-last the commit.
edits.after: Grandmaster-at-Arms lands with your R and beats it — bonus armour, MR, and a magic proc every third hit. Bait Counter Strike, trade short, then leave.

edits.before: Heartsteel timing — every proc widens the HP gap and your cleavers start hurting. Stand in the wave and dare Jax to trade into the regen.
edits.after: His Blade of the Ruined King timing beats your Heartsteel — on-hit percent damage eats the HP you just bought. Stop duelling, farm your side.

edits.before: Warmog's makes you a raid boss: full HP between every fight. Jax needs Grievous Wounds and a jungler to even slow you down — split, soak, win.
edits.after: Warmog's is not enough here: his ultimate's resists let him tank you while on-hit shreds the pool. Never take the 1v1 sidelane against a full Jax.

edits.before: Warmog's makes you a raid boss: full HP between every fight. Jax needs Grievous Wounds and a jungler to even slow you down — split, soak, win. Late game, play your win condition with the team — the lane is over; the habits it taught you are not.
edits.after: Warmog's is not enough here — his ultimate's resists let him tank you while on-hit shreds the pool, so never take the 1v1 sidelane. Late game, play your win condition with the team — the lane is over; the habits it taught you are not.

edits.before: Jax’s E dodges your autos and his on-hit + R out-scale your HP. Bait his E, build armor, and don’t extend into his late game. Track Counter Strike before every step-up.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges attacks but never your Q, and his ult out-scales you. Cash levels 1-5, build armor, don't extend late. Track Counter Strike before every step-up.

edits.before: - Jax Counter Strike (8s): matchup-defining — Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - Jax Counter Strike (17s at rank 1, 9s maxed): it dodges attacks, not abilities — keep throwing Q, and your passive eats the stun once. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call.

edits.before: Track Jax’s Counter Strike (8s): Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Counter Strike is 17s at rank 1 and dodges attacks, not abilities — keep the bonesaw flying.

edits.after: Level 6 flips to Jax: Grandmaster-at-Arms adds resists and a magic proc.

edits.after: R Grandmaster-at-Arms is Jax's whole game: bonus armour and MR plus magic damage on every third consecutive hit, flipping the trade the moment he ults — bait Counter Strike first and leave once he presses it.

notes: 'Grandmaster's Might' is the pre-rework name of Jax's R and appeared in four fields; Data Dragon gives Grandmaster-at-Arms. The packet's suspectNames was empty, so this one would have shipped unflagged — worth checking whether the name-matcher only compares against the current patch's ability list per slot. spikes[2].text and spikes[3].text also say 'his R resists' without naming it, which is fine as-is. tradeGood and breakdown.trading carry the usual scraped PDF junk ('• • Dr. Mundo Top Lane Matchup Database 28').
